response.client_id: Exact client record UUID, including closed and invoiced records; use for the authenticated clients record read.
response.client_portal_url: https://share.doctorcre.com/<slug> for the deal's active, non-disabled client portal; null otherwise. Derived at read time; never carries a password or hash.

phase_started_on.shape: object keyed by phase slug; YYYY-MM-DD values
phase_started_on.source: First event occurred_at per phase, in America/Chicago. A revisit does not replace the first start. Missing evidence has no key.

vendors.shape: Current detail returns an array of explicit active assignments; empty array when none. The archived-detail fallback may omit this field.
vendors.role: Specific service-role slug, displayed with underscores replaced by spaces.
vendors.order: Role, company name, contact name, vendor party id.

next_actions.hold_until: YYYY-MM-DD or null. An open action is held while hold_until is later than the current calendar date. Held actions remain in this history read. Accepted post-call actions return null.
next_actions.version: Positive integer from the action row, including accepted post-call actions. Closed actions remain in this read for completion readback.

response.short_name: Record-layer short deal name; fall back to the actual deal name when contact or market evidence is absent.

email_threads.shape: Optional array of {conversation_id, subject, latest_message_at}, newest message first; conversation_id and subject may be null. Missing on older servers.
email_threads.source: DoctorCRE/carr-system PR #2694 at b36239232aca073d062530d23f74e4aed40dd760: subject is outside-origin email_context.subject; latest_message_at is the latest email activity occurred_at.

checklist.source_of_truth: CARR doctrine sections, with runtime content-hash validation; the app renders producer items and statuses.
checklist.due_basis: Open, sourced critical_date records and unfulfilled checklist document requests. Confirmed fulfillment leaves document-delivery reminders. No legal or payment deadline is inferred.
checklist.receipt_basis: A fulfilled request projects received with its stored attachment evidence. The request retains fulfilled_at, fulfilled_by and evidence_attachment_id, with satisfied=false. Quarantined uploads alone do not prove receipt or completion. Authoritative lease, invoice and commission completion takes precedence.
checklist.first_slice: Current lease, expiration, invoice and full commission receipt derive completion. Unlinked documents and lifecycle LOI records remain not_recorded.
checklist.unavailable: Missing checklist storage returns no phases or due items; retain deal detail and its update form. Retry storage on each read.
